Byrne’s, X:9

I first heard the Chieftains play this in the early 70s and it became a favourite hornpipe. This setting is based on Jackie Daly and Séamus Creagh’s recording. They play it in G (or G#?) but this results in a high e, which is a bit high for most instruments (including mine), so I’ve transposed it down to the more usual D.

↳ Posted by brailsford on August 9th, 2026.
